OneTeamGovGlobal

OneTeamGovGlobal 2019

21 May 2019 Victoria Conference Centre, Victoria, British Columbia, Canada ~250 attendees

The first OneTeamGovGlobal held outside the UK; opened with a welcome ceremony from a Songhees Nation elder, and around 90% of attendees were first-timers.
